introduction: A kind but grieving widower volunteers at a school and meets a quiet third-grade boy who has not spoken all year. Together, they discover a magical pen and a diary, and the boy slowly begins to trust the man. Will he summon the courage to utter the one word that might lift the weight of the world off his shoulders? After all, some of the deepest conversations start with a single word …
